types.f32: IEEE-754 binary32 and must use distinct storage/round-after-each-operation semantics

exact_bit_semantics.Math.signbit: observe sign bit including negative zero and NaN
exact_bit_semantics.Math.ulp: spacing at the operand under the selected type
exact_bit_semantics.Math.fma: explicit fused multiply-add with one final rounding
exact_bit_semantics.Math.sqrt: correctly rounded when capability is declared

approx_eq.signature: Math.approx_eq(a: f64, b: f64, abs_tol: f64, rel_tol: f64) -> bool
requirements: tolerances must be finite and nonnegative
same-sign infinities return true only when a == b before difference arithmetic

transcendentals.policy: A backend must publish and test a finite max-ULP bound per function before declaring portable support. Host libm presence alone is not evidence.
transcendentals.bitwise_cross_backend_parity: not required until a shared deterministic Oreslang implementation is adopted

portable_math: no target FTZ/DAZ mode unless explicitly selected outside portable Math
no a*b+c contraction into FMA except explicit Math.fma
constant folding must preserve the same observable result as runtime evaluation
